$comment: P69 (lane lm): <dlfcn.h>'s pseudo-handles — the values dlsym takes in place of a library handle — each C library's own: glibc RTLD_DEFAULT ((void *) 0) and RTLD_NEXT ((void *) -1l); Apple's RTLD_DEFAULT ((void *) -2), RTLD_NEXT ((void *) -1), RTLD_SELF ((void *) -3) and RTLD_MAIN_ONLY ((void *) -5). DSS's dlfcn.json shipped none of them (a program spelling RTLD_DEFAULT did not compile on any pair). The program prints each value and resolves `puts` through RTLD_DEFAULT and RTLD_NEXT. ✔MEASURED, this stdout and exit 42 from gcc 13.3.0 and clang 18.1.3 on glibc 2.39 (probe-reference-cc run 20261001-002946-f9614487) and Apple clang 21 on arm64 and x86_64 (run 20261001-003001-a5de01fb); glibc defines both names in every mode measured (no __USE_GNU gate), Apple hides all four under _POSIX_C_SOURCE without _DARWIN_C_SOURCE (run 20261001-002530-6e4eca44). No pe arm: Windows has no <dlfcn.h>.
